_comment: Single source of truth for orri's dev services. isopod regenerates code-server/settings.json (startupTerminals.terminals), code-server/tasks.json, services-start.sh, and hooks/urls from this file on every `isopod up`. NOTE: every service here is autoStart:false — orri launches them itself in workspace-start.sh as the 'dev' user with dependency sequencing (pnpm/bundle install waits + first-boot DB seeding) that a flat manifest can't express. This manifest drives the *view* surfaces (startup terminals, command-palette tasks, URL list) plus log pre-creation; it does not own the launch.

services.startCommand: rm -f tmp/pids/server.pid; bundle exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3000
rm -f tmp/pids/server-ci.pid; RAILS_ENV=ci bundle exec rails server -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3001 -P tmp/pids/server-ci.pid
